newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.634 million yuan from 3.792 million yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading remained relatively active on Friday with short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, trading actively.
Shanghai and Beijing centres were the major net lenders today while Shandong and Jiangxi were the major borrowers, they said.
Friday was the second quarter settlement day for financial institutions, which increased trading in the short-term financial centres despite the impending holiday, traders said.
But state banks were unwilling to hold large positions before the three-day holiday, traders said.
The exchange will close from Sunday to Tuesday to mark the Chinese takeover of Hong Kong, the exchange has said. There will be an extra day of trading on Saturday in compensation.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move little in slow trading on Saturday ahead of the holiday.
